items.excerpt: iRobot launched five new self-emptying Roomba robot vacuums priced at or under $1,000 — its first U.S. products since bankruptcy and acquisition by Picea Robotics. The flagship Roomba Max 775 pairs LiDAR mapping and camera obstacle avoidance with a self-cleaning mop dock for 'fully hands-free' operation.

Chinese robotics company Agibot brought its full-sized A3 and half-size X2 humanoid robots to a London launch event, pitching robots that 'understand you, talk to you and work for you.' TechRadar met the dancing, 10-hour-battery humanoids up close.

Apple's rebuilt AI-powered Siri launches as a beta in iOS 27 this fall, but only on Apple Intelligence-compatible devices. The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max get extra on-device capabilities like expressive voices and improved speech recognition.

Apple released iOS 27 beta 3, its latest developer build testing the headline 'Siri AI' upgrade — richer conversations, personal context and on-screen awareness powered by next-generation Apple Intelligence — ahead of a fall public launch.

Apple is reportedly developing a smart ring to rival the Oura Ring and Samsung Galaxy Ring, according to leaker Kosutami — reviving the 'iRing' rumor as AI-driven health wearables like the $399 Oura Ring 5 gain momentum.

A leaked Galaxy Glasses manager app reveals Samsung's AI eyewear will run One UI XR and integrate with Galaxy watches and rings for gesture control. The glasses, built with Google, Qualcomm, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, are expected at the July 22 Unpacked.

A major leak details Samsung Galaxy Glasses controls, pairing modes and how the Gemini-powered AI eyewear might work with Galaxy smartwatches and rings. 'Samsung's Galaxy Glasses aren't supposed to launch until the fall but this may be our best look at them yet.'
Notebookcheck reviews the Microsoft Surface Pro OLED 2026, the flagship Copilot+ convertible with Qualcomm's Snapdragon X2 Elite SoC and OLED panel — a look at how far Arm-based NPU AI PCs have come.

Apple's new AI smart home features in iOS 27 and macOS 27 — facial recognition and intelligent video search for home cameras — are locked behind the 2TB iCloud+ tier at $9.99/month, tying AI home hardware features to its priciest subscription.

A developer is giving his home AI, Hana, a physical body one sensor at a time — from a self-correcting spatial camera map to health attachments like a pulse oximeter — with hardware-level safety limits blocking autonomous control of water valves and gates.

The race to better AR glasses is accelerating: Rokid announced new wired AR glasses with a tri-camera system for spatial tracking and AI environment recognition — and it's not just Google and Xreal's Aura glasses pushing the boundaries.

Nothing unveiled the $99 Ear (3a) true wireless earbuds with up to 45dB ANC and 42 hours of battery life. Each earbud carries three microphones with AI-powered noise reduction for intelligent sound filtering during calls and recordings.

Samsung is testing One UI 9 on more Galaxy devices ahead of its official debut, with the upcoming foldables first to ship the Android 17-based release out of the box — the OS wave that carries Samsung's next batch of Galaxy AI features.
Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods Pro — a key piece of its AI wearable roadmap for Visual Intelligence — may have hit a major development roadblock, per a new report.
Apple says the iOS 27 public beta arrives this month, bringing the waitlisted Siri AI revamp to a much wider pool of devices ahead of the fall release.
